reference.edition: EveryonePiano C-major 26-bar piano melody, complete two repetitions

review_method: Root逐音视读完整适用公开乐谱，逐项对照现有来源及编配时值。 所有正式ScoreCodec事件均与已审时间线比较；隔离导入和重启校验通过，软件虚拟播放未发送真实输入。人工听感未验证，真实游戏未测试。
review_note: complete-existing-52-bar-EOP-melody;all-accompaniment-and-loader-silence-explicitly-accounted All 652 EOP note pairs and all 1304 note-on/off events plus 370 union-of-voices silent intervals are independently decoded and accounted. All 26 printed melody bars are played twice, exactly matching the EOP repeat extent and end-repeat sign. No phrase or ending is truncated. Every output melody pitch and onset has exactly one original EOP match; other original pairs are individually listed as omitted piano accompaniment, including low out-of-game-range bass and chord tones. Original two-second loader lead-in is explicitly removed. Original source timestamp and gate duration remain in the comparison. Musical repeat structure starts at first note. Staccato dots are articulation, not augmentation. Restore nominal quarter/eighth/sixteenth lengths and real rests, using 10 ms note release gap as deliberate harmonica practice articulation; no claim to reproduce piano staccato gate envelopes. Full 52 bars, including every repeat and final C5 quarter note, remain. m8 C6 MIDI84 stays at printed pitch. Root逐图复读两页并另录26小节绝对MIDI/时值，完整双遍354事件全部与候选相同；root已见代理脚本，诚实标为非盲二读。 原EOP以已审查格式解码器重新解码652音/1304on-off/370静默，并按原位音高起点另逐项查全部330输出音；322伴奏音完整列省略。此处复用了既有二进制解析器，不冒称另一套独立解析器。 m8 C6不折叠，m10的E5到E4、m14的C4半音符均从五线谱核对；双遍52小节208拍、末C5一拍保留。 采用印刷110BPM和名义谱值，顿音点只作演奏法，标准10ms释放为明确练习选择。源头2秒准备空白明确移出音乐主体，未假称源里不存在。
limits: No human listening, original-recording alignment or real-game test.
Nominal written-note duration with 10 ms output release gap is an explicit practice articulation choice.
Original source content was seen before numeric reference transcription; no blind-review claim.
复核只覆盖来源现有内容；片段不代表整首录音。
软件检验不代表人工听感或真实游戏效果。
availability: Full source scores, corrected files, recordings and visual evidence remain local-only.
